faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Labour Welfare Superintendent recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) to fill multiple vacancies under the Labour Welfare Department on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Labour Welfare Superintendent post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for the Labour Welfare Superintendent position across various categories as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form for the MCD Labour Welfare Superintendent recruitment is 02-11-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation Degree along with a Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Social Work, Labour Welfare, Industrial Relations, or Personnel Management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Labour Welfare Superintendent role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years, with age relaxations applicable to SC, ST, and OBC candidates from Delhi as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary provided for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary under Level-7 amounting to Rs. 44,900 plus Variable Dearness Allowance (DA) as per departmental norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to send the filled application form via post or submit it directly.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be submitted in the DAK section of the Labour Welfare Department, MCD, 21st Floor, Dr. SPM Civic Centre, J.L. Nehru Marg, New Delhi - 110002.

faq.question: Q9. How is the selection process structured for these candidates?
faq.answer: The selection is based on a merit calculation taking weightage from Secondary, Senior Secondary, Graduation, and Post Graduation marks, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi for this recruitment drive.
